create_robot_dataset: create a RobotDataset instance to load robot manipulation data from H5 files with domain randomization and point cloud processing
get_datum_from_trial: get a single training datum from a trial with keypoint index including point cloud, gripper pose, and proprioceptive data
process_images_from_view: process RGB and depth images from a camera view into a structured point cloud with semantic features
get_gripper_pose: transform end-effector pose to gripper-end position with grasp offset and return 6D pose matrix
extract_manual_keyframes: extract indices of all user-tagged keyframes from a trial's user_keyframe array
